profile.name: Frederik Heda
profile.claim: I build and lead teams that ship agentic AI.
profile.now: Leads the AI team in trading and shipping: 6 teams, around 40 people, building agentic AI applications and other AI-enabled solutions.
profile.headline: AI & Engineering Lead

paragraphs: Career arc: where Frederik started, and how he moved from data science into leading AI engineering teams.
How he leads: small teams that own a problem end to end, shared evaluation before new features, and shipping to real users early.
What he cares about: agentic systems that are useful, measurable and safe, and engineers who grow by shipping.

experience.impact: Grew the AI function to 6 teams and around 40 people shipping agentic applications.

projects.title: Paper Podcasts
projects.plainEnglish: It reads new research papers and turns them into a short podcast I can listen to on a walk.
projects.techLine: Python pipeline: arXiv, LLM summaries, text to speech, FastAPI and React.

caseStudy.problem: I can't keep up with new AI research, and most papers never get read. Turning them into audio makes dead time useful.
caseStudy.built: A pipeline with four steps: download the paper, extract the text, write a summary and turn it into audio. I wanted to try building something as a finite state machine, and because it felt like a good choice for making each step resilient. A step that fails is retried without starting over. A library page shows the episodes and what I have listened to.
caseStudy.architecture:
flowchart TB
  subgraph BR["Browser"]
    UI["Library page: episodes and listen state"]
  end
  subgraph APP["Azure Container Apps"]
    API["FastAPI backend"]
    subgraph PIPE["Pipeline, a state machine"]
      D["Download from arXiv"] --> X["Extract text"] --> S["Summarise with an LLM"] --> A["Text to speech"]
    end
  end
  subgraph DATA["Storage"]
    ST[("Papers and audio")]
  end
  UI --> API --> D
  A --> ST

projects.title: TfL agent
projects.plainEnglish: Ask how the Tube is doing, and a second deployed agent answers.
projects.techLine: MCP tools on Azure Functions and an A2A agent over live TfL data.

caseStudy.problem: I wanted an agent that can answer any question about how to get from A to B in London.
caseStudy.built: An MCP server over the TfL API, used by a LangGraph agent. The server offers five tools: line status, disrupted lines, station search, journey planning and arrivals.
caseStudy.architecture:
flowchart TB
  subgraph CALLERS["Callers"]
    C["Another agent or client"]
  end
  subgraph AGENT["LangGraph agent, served over A2A"]
    AG["Tube agent"]
  end
  subgraph FN["Azure Function App: MCP server"]
    T["Five tools: line status, disrupted lines, station search, journey planning, arrivals"]
  end
  subgraph EXT["External"]
    TFL["TfL API"]
  end
  C --> AG --> T --> TFL

projects.title: CopilotKit agent canvas
projects.plainEnglish: A playground where an assistant builds charts and documents on a canvas while we talk.
projects.techLine: Next.js 16, CopilotKit v2 and AG-UI, a LangGraph agent with frontend tools, A2A delegation, Playwright suites, Azure Container Apps.

caseStudy.problem: I wanted a place to test new agent technologies without being tied to specific products.
caseStudy.built: A chat with a canvas next to it. The agent draws charts and writes documents there, and it hands questions to other agents over A2A. I use it to try AG-UI, A2UI-style charting and whatever comes next, one piece at a time.
caseStudy.architecture:
flowchart TB
  subgraph BR["Browser"]
    UI["Next.js 16 and CopilotKit v2: chat and canvas"]
  end
  subgraph BE["Backend on FastAPI"]
    AG["LangGraph agent"]
  end
  subgraph OTHER["Second agent"]
    FA["LangGraph agent served over A2A"]
  end
  UI -- "AG-UI" --> AG
  AG -- "frontend tools: charts, documents" --> UI
  AG -- "A2A" --> FA

projects.title: Restaurant Researcher
projects.plainEnglish: A personal venue finder with an agent that learns what I like.
projects.techLine: Next.js, CopilotKit and a LangGraph agent over Google Places.

caseStudy.problem: Recommendation apps know what everyone likes. I wanted one that knows what I like.
caseStudy.built: A card board for finding restaurants in London, with an agent that looks into each place and learns my taste. I am still building it.
caseStudy.architecture:
flowchart TB
  subgraph BR["Browser"]
    UI["Next.js 16 frontend: card board and chat"]
  end
  subgraph BE["Backend"]
    API["FastAPI backend"]
    AG["Research agent, in progress"]
  end
  UI --> API --> AG

projects.title: SHAP contribution
projects.plainEnglish: I contributed to SHAP, an open-source library for explaining why a machine-learning model made a prediction.

caseStudy.built: I contributed to the open-source repository.
